name: Aimia Inc.
source: Audited consolidated statements of operations, Aimia Inc. annual financial statements for the years ended 31 December 2025 and 2024 (page 9) and for the years ended 31 December 2023 and 2022 (page 8, 2022 as restated in note 2), PwC audited, CAD millions scaled to units. FY2025 and FY2024 reconcile as printed: revenue less cost of sales equals gross profit, and profit before tax less income tax equals net earnings. FY2023: 291.2 less 225.3 equals 65.9 gross profit; -53.9 operating result plus -83.5 of investment items, -17.5 financial expense, -25.2 carried interest and -0.5 capital liability equals -180.6 before tax; less 8.0 tax equals -188.6 net. FY2022: 1.5 revenue, 32.1 operating expenses, -30.6 operating result plus 475.0 of investment items, -3.0 financial expense, 1.0 carried interest and 2.9 capital liability equals 445.3 before tax; less 5.2 tax equals 440.1 net.

rows.label: Revenue
rows.note: Revenue from contracts with customers, consolidated statements of operations, as printed.

rows.label: Cost of Sales
rows.note: Cost of sales as printed. FY2022 carries a printed nil.

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.note: Selling, general and administrative expenses plus the impairment charge, both as printed.

rows.label: Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.note: FY2025 and FY2024: operating income or loss as printed. FY2023 and FY2022: gross profit less operating expenses (derived, because those statements print earnings before investment items only, which includes gains on disposal of equity-accounted investments).

rows.label: Net Finance Costs
rows.note: Financial expenses, net, as printed in each audited statement. The two earlier values in this file were a reconcile-to-profit-before-tax plug that absorbed investment gains and carried-interest movements; replaced with the printed line so every column is the same audited row.

rows.label: Profit Before Tax
rows.note: Earnings (loss) before income taxes as printed.

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.note: Income tax expense as printed, current plus deferred, expense positive.

rows.label: EPS
rows.note: Basic earnings (loss) per common share as printed. FY2025 is the positive 0.38 the statement prints against a net loss, which is what the filing shows.

rows.label: Net Margin (%)
rows.note: Net profit over revenue. FY2022 withheld: revenue of 1.5 million makes the ratio meaningless.

rows.label: ROE (%)
rows.note: Not collected: no balance sheet is carried in this file for the added years.

rows.label: ROA (%)
rows.note: Not collected: no balance sheet is carried in this file for the added years.

rows.label: Debt to Equity
rows.note: Not collected: no balance sheet is carried in this file for the added years.

rows.label: Operating Margin (%)
rows.note: Operating profit over revenue. FY2022 withheld: revenue of 1.5 million makes the ratio meaningless.
